dsneckfix_pdc.configuration.paperDollHum: Scale paper doll to human size

Scale the dragon model to normal human height in the paper doll preview.
Default: true
dsneckfix_pdc.configuration.dragonDamage:
Show DragonSurvival dragons with the vanilla hurt flash and death fall.
Default: true
dsneckfix_pdc.configuration.paperDollGli:
Let the paper doll dragon pitch up and down while gliding like the world dragon.
Default: false
dsneckfix_pdc.configuration.paperDollRid:
Render the full riding chain in the paper doll.
Only supports tr7zw and Fuzs paper dolls; YSM is not supported.
Default: true

Keep the whole riding chain on screen.
Only used when paperDollRidingChain is enabled.
Default: true
